description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_PropertyListIterator, which extends FilterIterator to filter a list of properties based on a prefix filter.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PropertyListIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for filtering property lists by prefix. Not to be instantiated directly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an iterator and an optional prefix filter string.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the current element is accepted based on the prefix filter.
